def expected_accepted(cap: int, n: int) -> int:
    """Number of sends a channel of capacity cap accepts when n elements are offered without blocking."""
    pre cap >= 0
    pre n >= 0
    post out >= 0
    post out <= cap
    post out <= n
    ex expected_accepted(2, 3) == 2
    ex expected_accepted(5, 2) == 2
    ex expected_accepted(0, 1) == 0
    ex expected_accepted(3, 0) == 0
    if cap < n:
        return cap
    return n

def accepted(cap: int, xs: list[int]) -> int uses nondet:
    """Create an int channel with capacity cap and try to send each element of xs without blocking. Return how many sends were accepted before the channel was full, stopping at the first refused send."""
    pre cap >= 0
    post out >= 0
    post out <= cap
    post out <= xs.len()
    post out == expected_accepted(cap, xs.len())
    free = cap
    count = 0
    for x in xs:
        if free == 0:
            break
        free -= 1
        count += 1
    return count
